# espalier_volume (Data Source)

A volume of the container runtime, e.g. one created outside Terraform, as the `espalier_volume` resource describes it. Fails if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "espalier_volume" "data" {
  name = "app-data"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume.

### Read-Only

- `format` (String) Filesystem of the volume, e.g. `ext4`.
- `id` (String) The volume's name.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the volume.
- `options` (Map of String) Driver-specific options (`--opt key=value`). Use `size` for the size, not an option.
- `size` (String) Size in bytes, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix, e.g. `2G`. If not set, the runtime creates a sparse 512 GiB image.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the volume in bytes.
- `source` (String) Host path of the volume's disk image.
